title: MACHEREY-NAGEL NucleoMag® NGS Clean-Up Protocol
author: MACHEREY-NAGEL
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Fill 12‑Well Buffer Reservoir
steps.instruction: Fill the 12‑Well Buffer Reservoir with the appropriate buffers as specified in the protocol table.

steps.title: Resuspend NucleoMag beads
steps.instruction: Vortex the NucleoMag® NGS bead suspension to fully resuspend the beads.

steps.title: Load and set up deck
steps.instruction: Place all required labware on the OT‑2 deck according to the displayed positions or deck map provided in the protocol.

steps.title: Place lysate block on magnet
steps.instruction: Put the square‑well block containing the lysates onto the Magnetic Module and start the run.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the required protocol parameters (volumes, incubation times, etc.) into the OT‑2 software interface.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol files and unzip them if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware and upload any custom labware JSON files.

steps.title: Upload Python protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the .py protocol file to the Protocol tab of the OT App.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette; consult support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the automated NucleoMag® NGS cleanup.
